f.clause: Appendix Ic: Special Reporting Timelines for Clinical Trials in Phase I and Public Health Emergencies
f.applicability: Phase I trials and trials during public health emergencies

f.title: Phase I and emergency trials: report foreign regulatory decisions within 48 hours
f.statement: In phase I and public health emergency trials, foreign regulatory decisions that affect the safety or use of the product are reported within 48 hours of becoming aware, as a detailed report.
f.clause: Appendix Ic: Reports from foreign sites
f.applicability: Phase I trials and trials during public health emergencies
